derivation.summary: 12 BIP39 words plus a passphrase, scattered across 3 password-gated web pages, derived along BIP84 to a P2WPKH address matching the escrow; the author separately published the account xpub
derivation.certified_against: the published account xpub, whose m/0/0 P2WPKH address equals the escrow; a known-wrong BIP39 test vector is also confirmed to produce NO MATCH. tools/seedsearch.py additionally certifies the BIP39-mnemonic-to-seed leg against the public 'abandon...about'/TREZOR seed vector and the BIP84 vector address bc1qcr8te4kr609gcawutmrza0j4xv80jy8z306fyu

difficulty_note: seed words 1 to 5 are printed in the open on one East page as numbered tags; the remaining words and the passphrase are not located, and the 3 password-gated pages are the likely place they sit, each requiring a specific author-intended answer to a riddle rather than a decodable cipher; about 5,000 candidates have been tried across the 3 locks with 0 hits, none of them a certified exhaustive negative, and a circulating 11-word seed fragment was swept over every single missing word with no match
